evidence:
Inspected the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl (not workbook-content.json): Quality Checks!A54:E54 identifies number 53 and requires that the task "reads as authored for this product, fits the suite's domain plan, and isn't a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling." Internal Quality Checks row 54 repeats the same requirement, has no additional nonempty annotation, and neither row has a cell comment. Applied .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/quality-checks.md:212-214: compare sibling names/concepts; the defect is "same flows, same criteria, renamed entities." Staged-task-contract.md permits shared harness structure; deterministic-checks.md supplies no separate mechanical originality test. Current REVIEW_POLICY.md does not turn shared persistence or concurrency patterns into a cloning defect.

The product-specific ask is explicit at .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/instruction.md:1 ("write JavaScript, HTML or CSS, see the result beside the editor"), :3 (restore "the last good preview" after an error or Stop), and :7 (ready-to-use code/preview/console). .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/task.toml:6-15 identifies a local code playground, code-playground/devtools keywords, isolation/stopping/restoration/concurrent saved snippets as difficulty, and provenance as an adaptation of the supplied Colderwater task. Its local domain fit is consistent with this declared developer-tool slice and the authoring plan in NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:195-203, which permits infrastructure reuse while requiring distinct domain behavior; TASK_AUTHORING_WORKFLOW.md:40-58 calls for a coherent product and domain notes. This finding does not claim verification of an external assignment tracker or unseen portfolio.

All six public notes were inspected. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5 specifies JS/HTML fresh documents versus CSS applied to a fresh isolated copy with no old scripts/handlers; :9 gives a single five-second callback budget; the Errors paragraph requires entered-source line numbers including full HTML markup; Console and automatic runs defines level-aware inspectable logs and debounce. security.md:3-9 defines the preview origin boundary and bounded unsupported execution families, while allowing harmless mentions of those words. overview.md and policy.md define a shared local snippet library without accounts; ui.md defines editor/preview/console panes. seed_data.json contains an empty snippets list and a playground-specific start-scope note, not a renamed transactional dataset. These linked choices are meaningful developer-tool behavior, not generic renamed records.

Parsed and inspected all five frozen judge files: the functional rubric contains 64 outcome rows, alongside 2 gate rows, 7 Polish rows and 6 Visual rows. Examples of materially specific criteria are .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:52 (cw_css_apply_snapshot), :73 (cw_css_inert_copy), :150 (cw_literal_loop_deadline), :171 (cw_js_error_line), :192 (cw_html_error_line), :255 (cw_console_value_inspection), and :416 (cw_callback_shared_run_deadline). The actual S02 protocol in functional/prompt.md:124 changes dispatch.JS to dispatch.HTML to dispatch.CSS, checks a formerly working handler becomes inert, and preserves authored DOM/style. S10 at :261 deliberately calls items.forEeach on entered line 4 and checks the most recent successful preview; S11 at :274 checks an HTML error at document line 6. These are not sibling flows with substituted product nouns. Polish and Visual descriptions consistently refer to playground surfaces, even where topic names and general anchors are shared infrastructure.

Compared the local projects instruction inventory, then inspected the closest domain relatives and their complete functional criterion inventories. PatchPad v3 instruction.md:3-5 asks for long incident-report editing; environment/assets/instructions/editing.md requires word/grapheme selection, multicarets, block indentation and atomic undo; persistence.md specifies historical revision preview/restore. Its tests/functional/judge.toml:231 grades revision-history preview/undo, :249 multicaret typing, and :240 chained stale saves. GridForge v3 environment/assets/instructions/spreadsheet.md specifies an 80x20 cell grid, formulas, relative-reference fill and TSV/CSV input; tests/functional/judge.toml:104 grades formula precedence and :139 dependency recalculation. Boardloom environment/assets/behaviour.md specifies 10px grid geometry, attached connectors, groups and component instances; tests/functional/judge.toml:80 checks connector attachment after movement/reload. These sibling core flows are absent from Colderwater, and Colderwater's execution/console/sandbox/preview recovery flows are absent from those sibling products. Shared stale-save, persistence, theme and keyboard concerns do not establish the same task.

Inspected corresponding implementation portions as corroboration of authored domain work: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/solution/app/src/runtime.ts:192 builds runs, :241 and :252 create sandboxed preview iframes; src/app.tsx:7 lists JS/HTML/CSS runnable examples, :147 brands Colderwater, and :152-155 implements the editor and conflict recovery surface; server.js:72 and :84 save snippet fields and revisions. These observations support the specific product vocabulary and state model; they are not used to claim runtime correctness.

Read-only verification recomputed SHA256 for every manifest-bound frozen input: 50 task files and 34 rule/template files, with zero mismatches. The review was static source/concept comparison. No browser, configured judge, Oracle, target-model or hosted QC run was made or claimed for this row; raw-evidence-index.json explicitly records those runtime limitations. No credible row-53 clone or domain mismatch was found.
counterexample: False-fail alternative checked against the written contract: a conforming playground can reuse the shared SQLite/revision-save infrastructure, generic Visual anchors, a conventional three-pane layout, and an off-the-shelf editor. The public integration.md says frontend tools are up to the builder and permits editor components/CDNs; functional/prompt.md S19 explicitly does not prescribe an editor package. Such reuse does not remove the distinct execution/preview/console behavior and must not fail row 53. False-pass witness considered: rename PatchPad to Colderwater and rename reports to snippets while retaining only its report editor/history/conflict flows. Enter document.body.textContent="fresh-playground-witness"; console.log("fresh-playground-witness"); in its text editor. Mere source display/saving cannot satisfy frozen tests/gates/render/judge.toml:25, which requires the newly authored marker in both executed preview and console; CSS copying and S10/S11 source-line error/rollback protocols also cannot be obtained by renaming. This is a concrete static counterexample comparison, not an executed browser or judge run. No false-pass clone in the frozen candidate was demonstrated.
